title: The moment China's newest heavy rocket tore itself apart in the sky
title_candidates: What a Chinese rocket explosion looks like when caught on camera
China's Long March 7A was built for lunar missions. It didn't survive the first stage.
A Chinese rocket broke apart in midair, and someone filmed every second of it
The moment China's newest heavy rocket tore itself apart in the sky
China lost one of its most important rockets mid-flight, on camera
caption:
China's Long March 7A rocket broke apart during its first stage of flight, caught on camera from the ground. The Long March 7A is one of China's primary rockets for delivering satellites to orbit and supporting lunar missions, so this is a serious setback for their space program. Failures at this scale are rarely filmed with footage this clear.
